summary: Royal Caribbean Cruises Ltd. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into an underwriting agreement with BNP Paribas Securities Corp., BofA Securities, Inc., and Citigroup Global Markets Inc. to issue and sell $1.25 billion of 5.550% Senior Notes due 2034 in an underwritten public offering. The offering, expected to close August 20, 2026, will use net proceeds to repay floating-rate term loan borrowings and other indebtedness. No special-situation characteristics apply; this is a routine debt issuance under an existing shelf. The filing is a standard current report, and no strategic event or corporate action is involved.
